# Certified Handmade (https://www.certified-handmade.com/)

> Free, MIT open-source, 100% client-side Cryptographic Artwork Provenance & Proof of Human Art toolkit. Zero server uploads, no account required, no blockchain/NFTs, and local-only `.psd`/`.clip`/`.procreate`/`.kra`/`.sai2` working project structure verification.

## Core Capabilities
- **Proof of Human Art & Source Project Verification:** Locally verifies multi-layer working project files (`.psd`, `.clip`, `.procreate`, `.kra`, `.sai2`) in browser memory to block renamed flat images, then immediately discards the raw project file (never stored in IndexedDB or Google Drive) and signs only a salted SHA-256 commitment hash (`sourceCommitmentHash`), format, and layer count.
- **100% Local Ed25519 Signing & SHA-256 Pixel Integrity:** Computes canonical RGBA8 pixel digests and Ed25519 signatures entirely inside the browser via Web Workers.
- **Offline QR Certificates (Open-Source C2PA Alternative):** Embeds self-contained RFC 8949 CBOR + Base45 verification URLs (`#proof=...`) into lossless PNG borders or translucent in-image QR codes that survive offline inspection.
- **Client-Side Artwork Safety Gate:** Blocks AI-generated metadata (Stable Diffusion, NovelAI, ComfyUI, Midjourney), unauthorized embedded QR/barcodes, illegal content, and raw GPS camera photos 100% locally.
- **Zero-Knowledge Privacy:** No central server, no telemetry, no ads. Optional Google Drive (`drive.appdata`) sync stores only artwork images (`.png`/`.jpg`/`.webp`) and encrypted provenance records—never working project files.
